comments.text:
as per my research only 2 major drawbacks in star health compared with other companies policy. 

1. Restore instead of Recharge which makes it almost useless feature as the restore benefit will only trigger once an year after exhausting complete sum insured not partially which means if your 2nd claim is more than the remaining balance of sum insured + NCB you have to pay from your pocket.
2. Sub limits on modern treatments which are way costlier than these defined sub limits makes it less useful feature at least they should have allowed till sum insured like other companies do.

They should provide these benefits with additional premium or give these options as additional riders with some extra amount.
